message: Hey Jane, hope you're well! I wanted to give you a heads up before our next team lunch planning. As you know, I have celiac disease, which means I need to stick to a strict gluten-free diet. I really appreciate everyone's effort to include me, so I just wanted to remind you. Thanks for understanding!
For the upcoming team lunch, how about trying out that new Thai place?
Thank you so much for taking care of the team lunch planning.
What's our plan for our team lunch next week? Is @Jane scheduling it this time?
